```{r setup}
#| include: false
d <- readRDS(params$data_path)
e <- d$est
colors <- d$colors
source("app_helpers.R")   # display rounding and rating labels, same as the app
source("report_charts.R")
fam <- register_report_fonts("fonts")

usd   <- function(x) fmt_usd(x)
typst <- function(...) cat("```{=typst}\n", paste0(..., collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
esc   <- function(x) gsub("([#$\\[\\]@])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
level_name <- function(key, value) {
  lv <- RATING_LEVELS[[key]]$levels
  nm <- names(lv)[which.min(abs(lv - value))]
  sub(":.*$", "", nm)
}
st <- d$status
steps <- if (!is.null(d$steps)) d$steps else cost_steps(e)
```

))

# Estimate summary

```{r kpis}
#| output: asis
tile <- function(label, value, note, value_fill = colors$ink) {
  sprintf('[#set par(justify: false); #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("%s"))[%s] #linebreak() #text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 16pt, weight: 600, fill: rgb("%s"))[%s] #linebreak() #text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("%s"))[%s]]',
          colors$ink_muted, esc(label), value_fill, esc(value), colors$ink_muted, esc(note))
}
third <- if (!is.null(e$maintenance)) {
  tile("Total cost of ownership", usd(e$maintenance$tco),
       sprintf("%d yr maintenance, today's dollars", e$maintenance$maintenance_years))
} else {
  tile("Effort", paste(format(round(e$effort_person_months, 1), nsmall = 1), "person-months"),
       paste(fmt_int(d$billable$billable_code), "billable lines"))
}
typst(sprintf('
#grid(
  columns: (1.2fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 12pt,
  %s,
  %s,
  %s,
  %s
)
#v(0.3cm)
#block(inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), stroke: (left: 2.5pt + rgb("%s")), fill: rgb("%s"))[
  #text(weight: 600)[%s] #h(6pt) #text(fill: rgb("%s"))[%s]
]
#v(0.4cm)
',
  tile("Estimated cost", usd(e$cost_usd),
       sprintf("range %s to %s", usd(e$estimate_range$low), usd(e$estimate_range$high)), colors$primary),
  tile("Schedule", fmt_months(e$final_schedule_months),
       sprintf("cap %s, natural %s", fmt_months(e$params$max_schedule_months), fmt_months(e$natural_schedule_months))),
  tile("Team", fmt_fte(e$final_people), sprintf("cap %d people", as.integer(min(e$params$max_team_size, 8)))),
  third,
  switch(st$kind, ok = colors$decrease, watch = colors$warning, action = colors$increase),
  colors$bg, esc(st$word), colors$ink_muted, esc(st$detail)
))
```

  cat(sprintf(
    "Maintenance is projected at %.0f%% of the build cost a year for %d years, escalating 5%% a year. Total maintenance: %s nominal, %s in today's dollars (discounted at %.0f%% a year). **Total cost of ownership: %s.**\n\n",

## Assumptions

```{r assumptions}
#| output: asis
p <- e$params
bd <- d$billable
lines_label <- if (isTRUE(bd$has_docs)) {
  sprintf("%s billable (%s documentation and configuration lines excluded)",
          fmt_int(bd$billable_code), fmt_int(bd$total_code - bd$billable_code))
} else {
  fmt_int(bd$billable_code)
}
rows <- rbind(
  c("Lines of code", lines_label),
  c("Complexity", tools::toTitleCase(p$complexity)),
  c("Team experience", sprintf("%d of 5 (%s)", as.integer(p$team_experience), team_exp_word(p$team_experience))),
  c("Code reuse", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("reuse", p$reuse_factor), p$reuse_factor)),
  c("Tooling and process", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("tools", p$tool_support), p$tool_support)),
  c("Cost per developer-year (fully loaded)", fmt_usd(p$avg_wage, exact = TRUE)),
  c("Team cap", sprintf("%d people", as.integer(p$max_team_size))),
  c("Schedule cap", fmt_months(p$max_schedule_months)),
  c("Required reliability", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("rely", p$rely), p$rely)),
  c("Product complexity", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("cplx", p$cplx), p$cplx)),
  c("Required reusability", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("ruse", p$ruse), p$ruse)),
  c("Team continuity", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("pcon", p$pcon), p$pcon)),
  c("Domain experience", sprintf("%s (%.2f)", level_name("apex", p$apex), p$apex)),
  c("Maintenance", sprintf("%.0f%% of build a year for %d years", p$maintenance_rate * 100, as.integer(p$maintenance_years))),
  c("Discount rate", sprintf("%.0f%% a year", p$discount_rate * 100))
)
df <- as.data.frame(rows, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(df) <- c("Assumption", "Value")
print(knitr::kable(df, format = "pipe"))
```

# Plan options

```{r plan-text}
#| output: asis
pl <- d$plan
if (is.null(pl) || length(pl$plans) == 0) {
  cat("No plan options were computed for this estimate.\n\n")
} else {
  kn <- pl$know
  facts <- c(if (!is.null(kn$people)) sprintf("%d people available", as.integer(kn$people)),
             if (!is.null(kn$months)) sprintf("deadline %s", fmt_months(kn$months)),
             if (!is.null(kn$budget)) sprintf("budget %s", fmt_usd(kn$budget, exact = TRUE)))
  if (length(facts)) cat("Based on: ", paste(facts, collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste(pl$narrative, collapse = " "), "\n\n")
  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pl$plans, function(x) data.frame(
    Plan = x$label, Team = fmt_fte(x$people), `Team cap` = x$k, Schedule = fmt_months(x$months),
    Cost = fmt_usd(x$cost), Premium = if (x$premium > 1) sprintf("+%d%%", round((x$premium - 1) * 100)) else "none",
    Status = x$status$word, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  rownames(tab) <- NULL
  print(knitr::kable(tab, format = "pipe", align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l")))
  cat("\n")
}
```

# How the cost is built

```{r steps-table}
#| output: asis
sdf <- data.frame(
  Step = steps$name,
  Amount = ifelse(steps$kind %in% c("base", "total"), usd(steps$delta),
                  ifelse(steps$delta >= 0, paste0("+", usd(steps$delta)), paste0("−", usd(abs(steps$delta))))),
  `Running total` = usd(steps$running),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(knitr::kable(sdf, format = "pipe", align = c("l", "r", "r")))
cat("\n")
```

# Methodology

This estimate is produced with a calibrated **COCOMO II.2000** model (Boehm et al., *Software Cost Estimation with COCOMO II*, 2000).

**Effort.** Person-months are estimated as

`Effort = 2.94 × KLOC^B × EM_total × 0.85`

where `KLOC` is thousands of productivity-weighted code lines, `B` is 1.02 / 1.10 / 1.18 for low / medium / high complexity, `EM_total` is the product of the effort multipliers listed in the assumptions table, and 0.85 is a documented calibration for modern high-level frameworks.

**Schedule.** The nominal schedule follows `TDEV = 3.67 × Effort^D` with `D = 0.28 + 0.2 × (B − 0.91)`. Team size is effort divided by schedule, capped at your team limit (and at 8 people, beyond which coordination costs outweigh added capacity).

**Schedule compression.** If the schedule cap is tighter than the natural schedule, effort is increased by a smooth premium `ratio^1.25` (anchored to COCOMO II's SCED driver), capped at 2.0×. Teams of 6 or more carry a 10% coordination overhead.

**Cost.** Cost is effort × monthly rate, where the monthly rate is the fully loaded annual cost divided by 12. Non-code lines (documentation, configuration, markup) are excluded from billable size. Figures in this report are rounded for display; the underlying model is exact.

**Estimate range.** The ±30% band reflects typical COCOMO II estimation accuracy for uncalibrated projects. It is a heuristic accuracy band, not a statistical confidence interval. Actual cost depends on requirements stability, team specifics, and scope decisions outside this model.

**Maintenance.** Annual maintenance is a fixed share of build cost, escalating 5% per year; multi-year totals are reported both nominally and discounted to today's dollars.
